issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently assumes `from` is a file path with no stated precondition or unit test.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged the DecodedMap one-liner: it now resolves sources against the map's parent directory, which is spec-correct, but assumes `from` is a file path. If `from` is a directory, URL, or empty, '..' climbs too far. There is no documented precondition and no direct unit test in packages/utils — only a downstream snapshot.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync runs per stack frame on the error path with no cache and no try/catch.
issues.detail: getSourceMap performs blocking existsSync + readFileSync on every frame during error serialization inside Promise.all, with no memoization. readFileSync can still throw (EACCES, EISDIR, race after existsSync), which would crash the reporter and replace the user's test failure with a sourcemap error. Cache by file path and wrap in try/catch falling through to undefined.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns literal '{}' to mask missing map files, hiding real failures.
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file is absent the reader returns the string '{}' so convert-source-map parses an empty object and reports success. This conflates 'missing file' with 'empty map', silently swallows broken sourceMappingURLs, and leaks a dependency quirk through the abstraction. Return undefined/null and let the caller handle absence, or log at debug.

issues.description: Heuristic `!mod?.transformResult` as the external-module discriminator is undocumented folklore.
issues.detail: The branch relies on the unstated invariant that Vite leaves transformResult empty for externalized modules. If Vite ever populates it, source-map extraction is silently skipped. State the invariant Vite guarantees, or query externality through a supported API rather than inferring it.

issues.description: Source-map helpers live in test-run.ts instead of the source-map utilities module.
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are general source-map plumbing, not TestRun lifecycle. Co-locating them with the run reporter couples unrelated responsibilities and complicates reuse. Move them into packages/utils/src/source-map.ts (or a sibling) so TestRun depends only on the abstraction.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' in the same file with no stated reason.
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' at the top, but the new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. The codebase's convention is pathe; the inconsistency invites cross-platform path bugs and looks accidental. Pick one and stick to it.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a real fix in the right shape but delivered without the discipline its complexity demands. Three load-bearing issues have unanimous P1 consensus: the DecodedMap resolve() change has an unstated precondition on `from` and no direct unit test; the new getSourceMap callback does sync readFileSync per frame on the error path with no cache and no try/catch; and the '{}' sentinel in the map reader lies to convert-source-map about missing files. Secondary concerns include an undocumented Vite-internal heuristic for externality, helpers placed in the wrong module, and inconsistent path-library usage. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — tighten the screws before landing.
